basis: bHLH TF required for tapetum development and sporopollenin genes; ams is male sterile, tapetum in situ (Sorensen et al. 2003 Plant J). Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.33 vs 0.08) and c3; c8 was labeled with this list, so not independent.
source: 10.1038/s41477-025-02072-z; Sorensen 2003 Plant J; Lee2025 ST1 (Long 2021 list)

basis: Sporopollenin-precursor P450 expressed in tapetum; mutant lacks exine (Morant et al. 2007 Plant Cell). Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.13 vs 0.01); low detection in nuclei.
Sporopollenin fatty-acid omega-hydroxylase in tapetum; mutant has zebra exine (Dobritsa et al. 2009 Plant Physiol). Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.23 vs 0.03).
Fatty acyl-CoA synthetase for sporopollenin; tapetum in situ, mutant male sterile (de Azevedo Souza et al. 2009 Plant Cell). Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.23 vs 0.04).
Polyketide synthase for sporopollenin; tapetum in situ (Kim et al. 2010 Plant Cell; Dobritsa et al. 2010). Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.19 vs 0.04).
Polyketide synthase paralog of PKSA for sporopollenin; tapetum in situ (Kim et al. 2010 Plant Cell). Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.19 vs 0.02).
Tetraketide alpha-pyrone reductase for sporopollenin, tapetum-specific (Grienenberger et al. 2010 Plant Cell). Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.22 vs 0.04).
ABC transporter exporting sporopollenin precursors from tapetum; mutant male sterile (Quilichini et al. 2010 Plant Physiol). Best-detected c8 gene in Lee 2025 (0.35 vs 0.05).
Fatty acyl reductase for pollen-wall fatty alcohols; ms2 male sterile, tapetum expression (Aarts et al. 1997 Plant J). Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.18 vs 0.03).
Classic tapetum-specific promoter (Paul et al. 1992 Plant Mol Biol); function unknown. Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.13 vs 0.03).
Anther-specific beta-1,3-glucanase (callase component), tapetum promoter (Hird et al. 1993 Plant J). Lee 2025 DE c8 (0.28 vs 0.04); used in the paper's c8 label (not independent).

Tapetal oleosin made in tapetosomes, pollen-coat protein (Mayfield & Preuss 2000 Nat Cell Biol). Late tapetum only. Lee 2025 c3 log2FC 2.5 but pct.2 0.86 (ambient in every cluster): use relative level, not presence.
PHD TF required for tapetum PCD and pollen wall, expressed in tapetum at a narrow stage (Wilson et al. 2001 Plant J). Classic; not DE in Lee 2025.
bHLH TF for early tapetum development, upstream of AMS (Zhang et al. 2006 Development). Early stage only. Classic; not DE in Lee 2025.
MYB TF required for endothecium secondary thickening and anther dehiscence (Steiner-Lange et al. 2003 Plant J; Yang et al. 2007 Plant Cell). Classic; no endothecium cluster in Lee 2025.
source: classic: Steiner-Lange 2003 Plant J; Yang 2007 Plant Cell

basis: Meiotic crossover protein, msh5 reduces chiasmata (Higgins et al. 2008 Plant J). Lee 2025 called c9 "male meiocyte" from this gene alone; weak (0.11 vs 0.01) and c9 also has G2/M genes. Male and female meiocytes.
Meiosis-specific recombinase, expressed in pollen and megaspore mother cells (Klimyuk & Jones 1997 Plant J; Couteau et al. 1999). Classic; not DE in Lee 2025 c9.
Meiotic chromosome-axis HORMA protein required for synapsis (Armstrong et al. 2002 J Cell Sci). Classic; not DE in Lee 2025 c9.

Pollen-specific arabinogalactan protein, reporter in pollen; agp6 agp11 impair pollen tube growth (Levitin et al. 2008 Plant J). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c7 (0.89 vs 0.13), which the paper labeled "Anther" from other genes.
Pollen-specific AGP paralog of AGP6 (Levitin et al. 2008 Plant J; Coimbra et al. 2009). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c7 (0.87 vs 0.10), independent of the paper's label.
Pollen-specific pectin methylesterase needed for pollen tube growth (Tian et al. 2006 Dev Biol). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c7 (0.46 vs 0.05).

Male-germline R2R3 MYB required for generative-cell division and sperm specification (Rotman et al. 2005 Curr Biol; Brownfield et al. 2009 PLoS Genet). Classic; not DE in Lee 2025 (pollen grains removed).
Sperm-specific gamete fusogen (von Besser et al. 2006 Development; Mori et al. 2006 Nat Cell Biol). Classic; not DE in Lee 2025.

Male-gamete-specific histone H3, reporter in generative and sperm cells (Okada et al. 2005; Borges et al. 2012). Lee 2025 c11 (0.39 vs 0.004); used for the paper's label. Germline histone, not a proliferation marker.
Sperm membrane protein, reporter in sperm (Engel et al. 2005 Plant J); also in egg/ovule. Lee 2025 c11 (0.69 vs 0.005); used for the paper's label.
Gamete-expressed membrane protein, sperm and egg (Alandete-Saez et al. 2008). Lee 2025 c11 weak (0.12 vs 0.001).
D-type cyclin; Lee 2025 c11 100% vs 3% (also c7 0.22). Not used by the paper; cell-cycle gene, so check against Dividing_cells.

bHLH TF for guard-cell differentiation (Ohashi-Ito & Bergmann 2006 Plant Cell). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c5 (0.78 vs 0.04), which the paper left Unknown. Also specifies myrosin idioblasts in Brassicaceae: confirm with KAT1/SLAC1 (arabidopsis_leaf.tsv).
Myrosinase highly expressed in guard cells (Zhao et al. 2008 Plant Cell) and in phloem myrosin cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J). Lee 2025 c5 (0.93 vs 0.30). Not guard-specific.
source: 10.1038/s41477-025-02072-z; Zhao 2008 Plant Cell; Barth 2006 Plant J

basis: Myrosinase in phloem-associated myrosin cells, not guard cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J). Lee 2025 c5 (0.89 vs 0.31). Points to myrosin cells inside the paper's c5.
Myrosinase in myrosin cells and guard cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J). Use with TGG2 and without KAT1/SLAC1 to call myrosin cells.
FAMA is required for myrosin-idioblast development (Shirakawa et al. 2014 Plant Cell; Li & Sack 2014 Plant Cell); also guard cells. Lee 2025 c5.
source: 10.1038/s41477-025-02072-z; Shirakawa 2014 Plant Cell; Li 2014 Plant Cell

basis: HD-ZIP IV TF for L1/epidermal identity (Lu et al. 1996; Abe et al. 2003). Lee 2025 DE c4 (0.17 vs 0.06) and c10 (0.21). Pan-epidermal incl. guard cells. Same row in arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.

VLCFA elongase for cuticle; epidermis in situ; fdh has floral organ fusion (Yephremov et al. 1999 Plant Cell). Lee 2025 c10 (0.48 vs 0.11), an epidermal subcluster of the flavonoid state. Same row in arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.

Cuticular wax (alkane) biosynthesis enzyme of the epidermis; flp1 has pollen-coat and wax defects (Ariizumi et al. 2003). Listed as abaxial-epidermis marker in Lee 2025 ST1 (Nakayama 2005); weak DE c2 (0.26 vs 0.13). Also tapetum (pollen coat).
L1-specific protodermal gene, in situ (Abe et al. 1999 Plant J); highest in young organs. Lee 2025 c4 (0.24 vs 0.06), the proliferating young-primordium cluster.
Epidermis-enriched lipid transfer protein, promoter reporter (Thoma et al. 1994 Plant Physiol). Lee 2025 c2 (0.86 vs 0.43): broadly detected.
DUF569 protein; flower epidermis by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Extended Data Fig. 5f; ST3 "sepal, petal, stamen"). Not DE in any flower snRNA cluster. Non-flower probe panel.
SAM-domain protein; ST3 flower epidermis (sepal, petal, stamen) and seedling cotyledon epidermis by MERFISH, same paper (Lee 2025). Not DE in flower snRNA.
Putative oxidoreductase; outer epidermis of sepals and petals by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Extended Data Fig. 5b). Conflict: the same paper's ST3 lists it as silique mesocarp. Not DE in flower snRNA.

Chloroplast beta-carbonic anhydrase (C3 mesophyll; arabidopsis_leaf.tsv). Lee 2025 c2 (0.42 vs 0.15) together with RBCS/LHCB, i.e. sepal/valve mesophyll. Conflict: Lee 2025 ST1 (Nakayama 2005) calls it epidermis-specific in petals and stamens.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; irx5 collapsed xylem (Taylor et al. 2003 PNAS). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c12 (0.44 vs 0.03), labeled "Vascular" by the paper from other genes.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; irx3 collapsed xylem (Taylor et al. 1999 Plant Cell). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c12 (0.15 vs 0.007) and stem xylem MERFISH (ST3). Same row in arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; irx1 collapsed xylem (Taylor et al. 2000 Plant Cell). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c12 (0.29 vs 0.015).
VND-family NAC TF for vessel differentiation (Kubo et al. 2005 Genes Dev; VND2 less studied than VND6/7). Lee 2025 c12 (0.38 vs 0.009).
Xylem cysteine protease in tracheary-element PCD (Funk et al. 2002 Plant Physiol). Cross-study: Lee 2025 c12 (0.17 vs 0.014) and stem xylem MERFISH (ST3). Same row in arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.
UDP-xylose synthase for xylan; stem xylem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 ST3) and flower c12 (0.38 vs 0.02), same paper.
HD-ZIP III TF of (pre)procambium and xylem precursors (Baima et al. 1995). Lee 2025 c12 (0.15 vs 0.03), used for the paper's label. Same row in arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.

Plasma-membrane H+-ATPase in companion cells, promoter reporter (DeWitt & Sussman 1995 Plant Cell); flower and stem phloem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 ST3). Agreement would raise to high, but Lee snRNA puts it in c10/c8, not a phloem cluster, so kept medium.
Florigen made in companion cells (Takada & Goto 2003 Plant Cell); flower vasculature by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Extended Data Fig. 5c). Not DE in flower snRNA; low expression in flowers.
WAT1-related amino-acid exporter; flower vasculature by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Extended Data Fig. 5c legend gives the AGI; ST3 gives symbol only). Not DE in snRNA.
bHLH TF; flower vasculature by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Extended Data Fig. 5c) and stem phloem (ST3), same paper. Not DE in flower snRNA.
Glycine-rich protein; flower vascular and stem phloem by MERFISH (Lee 2025 ST3). Conflict: snRNA DE in c8 tapetum (0.11 vs 0.05) and c2.
Glycine-rich protein 5; flower vascular by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Extended Data Fig. 5d). Conflict: snRNA strongly in c10 flavonoid state (0.79 vs 0.13).
Uncharacterized; flower vascular cells by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Extended Data Fig. 5g). Conflict: snRNA DE in c2 (0.14 vs 0.04) and c7.
AP2/ERF TF; flower vascular by MERFISH (Lee 2025 ST3). snRNA DE only in c5 (0.25 vs 0.01), which fits phloem-associated myrosin cells in that cluster (inference).
Glycine-rich protein; flower vascular by MERFISH (Lee 2025 ST3). Not DE in flower snRNA.
B-class organ-identity MADS TF, in situ in whorls 2-3 (Jack et al. 1992 Cell). All cell layers of petals and stamens: a domain, not a cell type. Weak DE in Lee 2025 c2 (0.10 vs 0.05).
B-class organ-identity MADS TF, partner of AP3 (Goto & Meyerowitz 1994 Genes Dev). Domain marker. Weak DE in Lee 2025 c2 (0.14 vs 0.05).
C-class organ-identity MADS TF, in situ in whorls 3-4 (Yanofsky et al. 1990 Nature). Domain marker. Weak DE in Lee 2025 c10 (0.12 vs 0.04).
A-class MADS TF; after stage 3 restricted to sepals and petals (Mandel et al. 1992 Nature). Domain marker. Classic; not DE in Lee 2025.

MADS TF for valve differentiation, valve in situ (Gu et al. 1998 Development). Cross-study: carpel-valve MERFISH in Lee 2025 (Extended Data Fig. 5h; ST3 "Valve"), so raised to high. Also stem and cauline leaves. Not DE in flower snRNA.
MADS TF for valve-margin identity (Liljegren et al. 2000 Nature); also ovules. Lee 2025 c10 (0.26 vs 0.02).
bHLH TF for valve-margin dehiscence zone (Liljegren et al. 2004 Cell); strongest after anthesis. Classic; not DE in Lee 2025.
D-class MADS TF for ovule identity (Pinyopich et al. 2003 Nature). Lee 2025 c10 weak (0.14 vs 0.02).
YABBY TF expressed only in the abaxial outer integument, required for its growth (Villanueva et al. 1999 Genes Dev). In Lee 2025 ST1; not DE.
Synergid-specific MYB required for filiform apparatus and pollen-tube guidance (Kasahara et al. 2005 Plant Cell). Classic; female gametophyte is rare in nuclei data.
Egg-cell-specific secreted protein for sperm activation; family is redundant (Sprunck et al. 2012 Science). Classic.
Polycomb gene expressed in the central cell before fertilization (Luo et al. 2000 PNAS). Classic.
Zinc-finger TF required for transmitting-tract development (Crawford et al. 2007 Development). Classic; no carpel cluster in Lee 2025.
Nectary-specific sucrose efflux transporter required for nectar secretion (Lin et al. 2014 Nature). Classic; no nectary cluster in Lee 2025.
YABBY TF required for nectary formation, also carpel abaxial domain (Bowman & Smyth 1999 Development). Classic.
Chalcone synthase; Lee 2025 c10 (0.82 vs 0.25) and abaxial carpel by MERFISH (Fig. 4i). A metabolic state spanning tapetum, epidermis and female gametophyte subclusters, not a type.
Dihydroflavonol reductase; Lee 2025 c10 (0.56 vs 0.02), MERFISH Fig. 4j. State, not a type.
Anthocyanidin synthase; Lee 2025 c10 (0.59 vs 0.02). State, not a type.
Mitotic B-type cyclin, G2/M reporter. Lee 2025 c9 ("male meiocyte", 0.29 vs 0.01): flag that cluster for proliferation. Same row in arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.
Cytokinesis syntaxin. Lee 2025 c4 ("developing ovule", 0.12 vs 0.02), a G2/M young-primordium cluster. Same row in arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.
